hero.headline: Dikshant Kumar
hero.description: I craft clean, scalable, and interactive digital products with modern web architecture, elegant design systems, and resilient engineering.

description: Engineered 15+ interactive e-learning simulations for mathematical concepts using React.js, CSS, and Anime.js, delivering animation-driven experiences for K-12 and college-level audiences.
Collaborated directly with clients across the full product lifecycle — requirement gathering, UI/UX iteration, and deployment — consistently shipping production-ready features on schedule
Implemented gamified learning flows and real-time visual simulations, improving learner engagement across 15+ modules; optimised component performance for seamless cross-device experiences.

Architected a real-time hospital bed management platform supporting 500+ beds across multiple departments, using React.js, Express.js, and MongoDB, with role-specific dashboards and analytics for Admin, Doctor, and Nurse personas.
Implemented secure Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) with JWT authentication and a sector–service–bed hierarchy; built RESTful APIs for real-time bed tracking and dynamic allocation.
Integrated multilingual support and optimised backend for high-traffic operations; delivered iteratively with a remote client team, maintaining a stable production-ready codebase throughout.

projects.shortDescription: A modern application for managing student fees, invoices, and automated payment records.
projects.description: A complete institutional fee management system engineered to streamline student dues collection, ledger reports, and administrative receipts. Includes multi-role admin controls, exportable analytics, and automated Google Drive backup and data synchronization for secure data protection.

projects.shortDescription: A complete tailoring business management application for managing customers, measurements, orders, payments, and deliveries.
projects.description: A practical tailoring management system designed to streamline customer management, clothing measurements, stitching orders, payment tracking, delivery schedules, and order status management through a centralized workflow.

achievements.title: HackIndia 2025 Winner
achievements.description: Secured 1st position among 200+ teams by engineering a decentralized voting application using blockchain technology. The application provided secure, transparent, and tamper-proof voting with real-time result updates.
